name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare (Authless)
description: A template for deploying a remote Model Context Protocol server on Cloudflare Workers using Server-Sent Events without authentication. It enables developers to host custom tools that can be accessed by both the Cloudflare AI Playground and local MCP clients like Claude Desktop.
